buttons.text2: The ticket office in Kuźnice only sells tickets for the current day, just before the cable car departs. All people for whom tickets are purchased must be present directly at the ticket window. After purchase, passengers proceed to boarding. Each ticket includes its validity information. Return tickets from the upper Kasprowy station can only be purchased at the mountain station, depending on seat availability. Priority for descent is given to passengers with round-trip tickets. splyw-dunajcem-dluzszy.header3: Trip to the Pieniny Mountains: Rafting and Niedzica
splyw-dunajcem-dluzszy.header4: During the trip to the Pieniny Mountains, apart from the main attraction – a rafting trip on traditional wooden rafts – you will also visit Niedzica, where you can choose one of the following attractions:
splyw-dunajcem-dluzszy.text: We have prepared a range of fascinating attractions that will surely make your holiday time incredibly exciting and unforgettable. Our suggested Dunajec rafting tour from Zakopane is a fantastic way to enjoy stunning landscapes and explore many sites. The rafters will entertain you with captivating stories and legends related to the river and its surroundings. In addition to rafting on a wooden raft, where you can admire the beauty of the Pieniny mountains, the offer also includes the option to visit the castle in Niedzica, the Dunajec dam, or the Miniature Park of Podhale, Orava, and Spiš.

list.1: A boat cruise on Lake Czorsztyn (During the sightseeing cruise, you will admire the water dam, the ruins of Czorsztyn Castle, Niedzica Castle, the Czorsztyn open-air museum, and the stunning mountain scenery). Such a cruise is an adventure you will remember for a long time!
list.2: Niedzica Castle – where Janosik was imprisoned and tortured.
list.3: The Czorsztyn Dam with a spectacular 3D mural.
list.4: Miniature Park of Podhale, Orava, and Spiš, rope park.
list.5: On the way back to Zakopane, we’ll stop in Dębno, where there is a historic 15th-century wooden church listed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site – with a short 20-minute talk by the curator.

splyw-dunajcem-dluzszy.info: The rafting season runs from April 1st to October 31st – rain or shine, including Fridays and Sundays. So, we invite you to join us every day!

table.text: * Price includes: driver assistance during the tour and accident insurance (NNW)

tripprogram.3: Pick-up in Szczawnica and transfer to Niedzica

funfact.header: Fun Facts About the Dunajec Rafting
funfact.text1: The origin of the Dunajec Gorge is still not fully understood. According to legend, the famous knight Ferkowicz chased the King of Snakes through this route.
funfact.text2: The winding path he took was said to have turned into the Dunajec Gorge. Other highlanders claim that the river’s outlet was carved out by King Bolesław the Brave himself.
funfact.cta: Want to know more? Ask your rafter...

termy.text: Chochołowskie Thermal Baths is the largest thermal complex in the Podhale region. With large indoor and outdoor pools, the total water surface area amounts to 3000 m². The complex features both grassy and sandy beaches, offering everyone a perfect spot to relax. It includes both recreational and therapeutic zones.

spacer-w-koronach-drzew.text: The Treetop Walk Bachledka is located in the heart of the species-rich forest of the Pieniny National Park. It reveals why the nature of the Spiš Magura is so special. During this experience, you will become familiar with the local forests, become part of forest life, and learn about rare species of animals and plants. The trip starts early in the morning from Zakopane towards the Bachledova Valley. From there, you’ll take a round-trip gondola ride (approx. 7 minutes) up to the peak of the Spiš Magura.

list.1: While walking along the treetop path, you can stop at several stations with information boards, all easily accessible. These provide fascinating insights into local flora, fauna, forest life, its protection, and the destructive power of weather.
list.2: The over 600-meter-long route leads visitors through a diverse forest filled with surprises and interesting facts.

table.additional: Extra cost (gondola round-trip ticket + treetop walk entrance ticket)
table.text: * Price includes: driver assistance during the tour, accident insurance (NNW), and transport from Zakopane

tripprogram.2: Gondola ride to the top of Spiš Magura
tripprogram.5: Drive to Štrbské Pleso (Free time – 2 hours) **unavailable in winter season**
tripprogram.text: After the treetop walk, we return via gondola to the parking lot and head through the High Tatras (Tatranská Lomnica, Starý Smokovec) to Štrbské Pleso. There you’ll have free time. For those interested, a walk around the lake takes about 40 minutes. Štrbské Pleso – also known as Štrbské Lake – is located at 1,346 m above sea level. Often compared to Poland’s Morskie Oko, it’s surrounded by spruce forests severely damaged by a hurricane in 2004. The settlement has the status of a climatic health resort and is also a popular ski destination. It’s a beautiful place – and it almost disappeared in the 19th century, when locals wanted to drain the 20-hectare lake and turn it into pasture. After the lake walk, we return to Zakopane. The 600-meter-long path takes visitors through a diverse forest full of natural wonders and surprises.
tripprogram.text2: Discounts apply to: children up to 10 years old, schoolchildren up to 15 with valid school ID, students up to 26 with a valid Polish student ID, ISIC, or EURO 26 card, seniors 65+ with proof of age, one guardian per 10 schoolchildren, and licensed tour guides (guide ticket costs 35 PLN).

2.text: From local attractions like sleigh rides to river rafting – Trio Travel offers a wide range of services in one place. It’s the perfect solution for anyone wanting to make the most of their time in the mountains.

3.text: The company focuses on tailoring its offer to the client's needs. Whether you're looking for a relaxing trip or an active adventure, Trio Travel provides the flexibility to meet your expectations.

koscielisko.text: During your stay in Zakopane, we invite you to join our picturesque sleigh rides combined with a bonfire feast. A fantastic and unforgettable adventure, a unique atmosphere, breathtaking views, and great vibes. Join us for the organized Highlander sleigh ride in Kościelisko. A scenic ride in a sleigh through mountain landscapes will create a one-of-a-kind experience you won’t forget. The sleigh ride lasts for around 1 hour and is beautifully lit by torches. Afterwards, you’re invited to enjoy a bonfire with a delicious local meal and live highlander music.

dolina.text: A unique and one-of-a-kind opportunity to experience the magical winter atmosphere of the famous Chochołowska Valley! While staying at the foot of the beautiful Polish Tatra Mountains, a true highlander sleigh ride is a must. TrioTravel offers an exceptional sleigh ride in the Chochołowska Valley, away from the hustle and bustle of the city. The hour-long sleigh journey will be illuminated by torches, followed by a feast by a highlander bonfire, known as 'Watra'. A delicious refreshment will be waiting for you by the fire, accompanied by a live traditional highlander band.
dolina.info: Sleigh rides depart daily at 5:00 PM and 7:00 PM (Departure from Zakopane about 40 minutes earlier)

sylwester.text: Join us for an unforgettable New Year’s Eve in the magical scenery of Podhale! The New Year's Eve sleigh ride by TrioTravel is a traditional ride through snowy trails, ending with a bonfire and refreshments in true highlander style. It's a unique opportunity to ring in the New Year surrounded by nature, by the firelight, with music and local delicacies. Experience the magic of highlander hospitality with your friends and family – make the start of the new year truly unforgettable!
